body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Plantronics introduced 'BackBeat 216', earphone certified by iPhone, iPod and iPad at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

'BackBeat 216' featuring Base boost is possible for convenient call and music control because it is compatible with iPhone, iPod and iPad. Neodymium inline microphone offers high-quality sound and micro-speaker offers optimized sound of high-end and mid-range.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
